chapters.title: Prologue
chapters.summary: A voice in the Void, and a ruined palace at the end of it.

chapters.title: The Long Road
chapters.summary: Three lessons on the road away from the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter I
chapters.summary: A wall that outlived the war it was built for.

chapters.title: The Wall
chapters.summary: The old wall, its arsenal, its gate, its hospice, and the General who holds the line.

chapters.title: The Smith's Errand
chapters.summary: A finished sword, and a delivery nobody has been able to make.

chapters.title: Names on the Wall
chapters.summary: A mason still carving names, and a watch that was never relieved.

chapters.title: Chapter II
chapters.summary: Two roads leave the General's line.

chapters.title: Bell Tower
chapters.summary: The tower keeps the last day of the war. Every bell raises the dead.

chapters.title: Courtyard
chapters.summary: Three answers the King once asked for, and none of them helped.

chapters.title: The Hunters' Debt
chapters.summary: The hunters owe the tower a life. The collectors have come for it.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Ring
chapters.summary: An hour that will not end, kept by two hands that will not let go.

chapters.title: The Altar's Answer
chapters.summary: The altar only answers pain. The acolytes have run out of other questions.

chapters.title: The Unfinished Gallery
chapters.summary: A play nobody finished, still waiting for its last entrance.

chapters.title: Chapter III
chapters.summary: Beyond the bell and the court, two ways further down.

chapters.title: Dragon Tomb
chapters.summary: A machine that predicted the end of the war and was buried for it.

chapters.title: Blank Archive
chapters.summary: Every number in the histories has been quietly rewritten.

chapters.title: The Stone's Due
chapters.summary: The tomb keeps a tally of what the bones are still owed.

chapters.title: The Queue at the Gate
chapters.summary: A relief that finally arrived, and a gate that will not let it through.

chapters.title: Tomb Afterimages
chapters.summary: What the tomb kept of the war after the machine stopped counting.

chapters.title: The Missing Page
chapters.summary: One page was scraped clean, and the earlier text keeps surfacing.

chapters.title: The Quiet Reading Room
chapters.summary: One room in the archive is still quiet, and the warden intends to keep it.

chapters.title: Archive Overwritten
chapters.summary: Everything the archive wrote over, written again in the margins.

chapters.title: The Roofless Shelter
chapters.summary: The last stop before the last duel: a queue, a ferry, and a bench with one end repaired.

chapters.title: Finale
chapters.summary: The last duel, and the water beyond it.
